title: 26 of 35 active Hotspawn CS2 fixtures carry a model estimate, not a bookmaker line
detail: Live runner snapshot at 2026-10-22T02:05:52Z (run 39709449794). Every one of the 35 active fixtures has both probabilities and 34 have a directional pick, but only 9 come from a two-sided price (Polymarket/Kalshi/Thunderpick/Bovada/Pinnacle or their consensus). The other 26 come from a Valve-rating, HLTV-ranking, results or network model. Those rungs are explicitly uncalibrated: they do not know today's lineup, stand-ins or map veto, and Valve/HLTV publish team-level points rather than win probabilities. The site labels every one of them as a research model and lists them together on /unresolved/#research-only rather than presenting them as betting lines. This is the honest answer to 'a pick for every match': coverage is complete, market backing is not. What would change it: a reachable two-sided prematch series price for each fixture, which the ladder re-checks on every four-hour refresh.

title: Three model-backed picks were labelled "Valve official ratings" while the number came from the bo3.gg network model - fixed
detail: Verified line by line in the live snapshot and in scripts/originate.py. The last-resort ladder assigns `model = match['_network']` when the Bradley-Terry network rung exists, but the label block that follows only distinguished the results ('form') family from everything else, so every network-backed row was published as 'Research model estimate (Valve official ratings)'. In the 2026-10-22T02:05Z snapshot that was benched gods vs TitanFlow (1081597), K27 vs NEXORA (1082769) and Ground Zero vs Off Chops (1082858): their `family` was 'network' and their `provider` was 'Own network model (bo3.gg results graph)' while their label named Valve. No probability, pick or source URL was wrong; the provenance sentence was. Fixed in scripts/originate.py by deriving the label from the model's own family and adding the network-specific limitation (Bradley-Terry fit size, anchors, one-sigma interval). Re-running the ladder is what re-labels those rows; nothing was hand-edited, and the fix is covered by the existing origination/network suites.

title: HLTV's match listing rejected the runner with HTTP 403 while HLTV team search answered 200 for 67 of 70 lookups
detail: Measured, not assumed. With the repository's identifying User-Agent, https://www.hltv.org/matches returned HTTP 403 on all 35 fixture probes and https://www.hltv.org/search?query=<team> returned HTTP 200 for 67 of 70 team lookups and HTTP 403 for the other 3 (repeated identical requests inside one run). An earlier version of the same probe used a desktop-browser User-Agent and every HLTV request answered 403; that measurement was of the probe's headers, not of HLTV, and it was corrected before anything was published. Consequence: the pipeline can confirm HLTV identity from its own saved listing capture, but HLTV cannot be used as a live odds source from the runner, and no HLTV-sourced price is claimed anywhere. Access controls were not bypassed.

title: ex-Zero Tenacity vs ex-RUSTEC (1079654) is exactly 50/50 on Valve's published points, so it keeps no side
detail: Valve's 5 October 2026 regional standings publish 1066 points for both ex-Zero Tenacity (standing 93) and ex-RUSTEC (standing 92), and both rosters are complete five-player records. The 400-scale logistic expectation is therefore exactly 0.5/0.5. The project's rule is that an even estimate is never given an invented side, and picking the other available rung only because it is not even would be cherry-picking one model over another. The fixture is listed on /unresolved/ as an even estimate with its full trail. Every other active fixture carries a directional pick.

title: bo3.gg relayed a named Thunderpick price for 5 fixtures - all of them already priced by the ladder
detail: bo3.gg's public match objects carry a bet_updates block naming the bookmaker and both decimal coefficients. On 2026-10-22T02:05:52Z the probe bound 27 of 35 fixtures to a bo3.gg record and found a relayed price on 5 of them. Every one of those five already has a ladder price from Polymarket or Thunderpick directly, so the relay adds no pick and closes no gap. No relayed coefficient is used as a probability in this build; it is recorded in data/research/5fbf5cd5/live-2026-10-22/coverage.json with the bo3.gg match URL so the claim can be replayed. Published as a notice because a relay is a second-hand quote, not a first-party book.

title: Inventory reconciled: all 35 active records in Hotspawn's own array are on the site
detail: The runner read Hotspawn's scheduled-fixture array directly (97 records, HTTP 200, body SHA-256 recorded) and parsed each scheduled_start_time. 35 records start after the observation time and the published snapshot contains the same 35 ids: 0 missing from the site and 0 extra on the site. The first version of this probe looked for an ISO start field instead of the epoch-millisecond field Hotspawn actually publishes and silently reported zero active rows; that defect was fixed, retested against the saved payload (tests/test_5fbf5cd5.py) and re-run before this reconciliation was claimed.
